entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' for product help or 'Sales' for new orders.
Support.
Connecting you to a VeloFit support agent now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return a VeloBand Pulse. I already tried online and it said I couldn't. My order number is VF-8675309.
I can certainly look into that for you. One moment while I pull up your order... Okay, I see the VeloBand Pulse, purchased 22 days ago and delivered 19 days ago. Is that correct?
Yeah, that sounds about right. I just opened it and it's not what I expected. I want to return it.

I understand. I see the system denied the return because it is outside of our 14-day return window. Unfortunately, I won't be able to process a refund back to your original payment method for that reason.
What? That's ridiculous! I've been busy. It's only been 19 days! This is completely unacceptable.
I do apologize for the frustration. The 14-day policy is listed on our website at the time of purchase, and I am unable to override that for a cash refund.
This is absurd. I want to speak to your boss. Get me your manager right now.
I understand you'd like to escalate this, but I am fully empowered to find a resolution for you. My supervisor would have to tell you the same information regarding the cash refund policy.
I don't care what you're empowered to do. I want to speak to a supervisor. You're not helping me, you're just quoting policy at me.

Please allow me a chance to help. While a refund to your credit card isn't an option, what I can do is offer you the full value of the VeloBand Pulse as a store credit to your VeloFit account. That would be $150.
Store credit? I just want my money back. This is so frustrating.

I completely understand. I know this has been an inconvenient experience. To help make things right, in addition to the $150 store credit for the item, I can add an extra $25 inconvenience credit to your account. You'd have a total of $175 to use on any other VeloFit gear.
Wait, so... you'll give me the full price back in credit, and then add another $25 on top of it?
That's correct. I can email you a prepaid return label right now. As soon as we receive the VeloBand, the $175 credit will be active in your account.
Okay... wow. You know what, that actually works perfectly. I was looking at some of your cycling jerseys anyway. That's a great solution. Thank you.
You are very welcome! I'm happy we could find a resolution that works for you. I've just sent that email with the return label. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. I appreciate your help, Alex. Sorry I was so impatient earlier.
Not a problem at all. Thank you for being a VeloFit customer. Have a wonderful day!
